question: In a research study, what does a confidence interval of 95% mean?
options: A. 95% of the sample falls within this range
B. We are 95% confident the true population parameter lies within this range
C. 95% of studies will show this result
explanation:
• A 95% confidence interval means we are 95% confident that the true population parameter lies within this range.
• It does not mean 95% of the sample falls within the range or that the result is 95% accurate.
• Understanding confidence intervals helps nurses interpret research findings and apply evidence to practice.
• Research and statistics knowledge enables nurses to critically evaluate evidence.

question: In a research study with 95% confidence interval of 60-80, what does this mean?
options: A. 95% of sample values fall in this range
B. We are 95% confident true population mean is 60-80
C. 95% of studies will show this result
explanation:
• 95% confidence interval means we are 95% confident that the true population parameter lies within this range.
• It does not mean 95% of sample values fall in range.
• Understanding statistical concepts helps nurses interpret research findings and apply evidence to practice.
